# Brief: redesign getloopdesk.com (November 2026)

## What visitors told us
People who visited the site said it looks like a Romy website. Mohammed (founder) agrees, and also thinks the current design is not great.
It should read as Loopdesk, the company, first, and present the products in this order: Sinan first, then Romy.

## The hierarchy the site must show (Mohammed's words, ordered)
1. Loopdesk is the mother company.
2. Behavioural science is the core of the business.
3. Then comes automation, focused on appointment (booking-based) businesses.
4. Sinan is a product (dental clinics). Romy is another product (beauty centres). Sinan comes first.

## Facts and rules (must keep)
- Loopdesk: tech provider / growth partner for appointment businesses (dental clinics, beauty centres, cosmetic clinics, barbershops).
  Descriptor today: "Your growth partner. Behavioural science that brings clients back and sells more." Arabic line: «فنّ العودة… وسرّ الزيادة».
- Say "behavioural science", never "psychology". In Arabic علم السلوك.
- Sinan (dental, he): turns what each patient truly needs into something they want (the check-up they put off, the cleaning that's due,
  the treatment their dentist recommended). Writes in the dentist's name, books in one tap, works on the clinic's WhatsApp.
  Patients never see "Sinan": messages speak as the clinic. Also Google review ask, Instagram follow, click-to-WhatsApp ads, Instagram/Facebook DMs.
- Romy (beauty, she): notes in the stylist's name at the right moment, one extra that suits the client, warm win-back. Tagline
  "She knows beauty. She knows business. Above all, Romy knows when to say what."
- Both speak Arabic and English; Russian is coming soon. Both are "Coming soon" publicly. Cosmetic clinics and barbershops: later.
- No prices on the site. No "pilot", no "be one of the first", no "Built in the UAE". No invented customers, numbers, results or testimonials.
  Never show the number of people interviewed. No fake urgency.
- Copy voice: warm, playful, smart, humble; jokes about treatments, never about clients or bodies. Mixed-nationality sample names.
- Arabic: original (not translated), light clear Modern Standard Arabic, Western digits. Company-wide copy in plural; beauty copy feminine,
  dental masculine. Names in Arabic script. Beauty services are خدمات (never علاجات).
- Photos: real people, warm, no headscarves. No product-tech "dashboard deck" look.
- Footer keeps legal name LOOP DESK SOLUTIONS - FZCO, licence, Dubai Silicon Oasis address, phone +971 50 147 2513, privacy and terms (Meta verification).
- The site has a call-back form (/api) and WhatsApp chat buttons (Loopdesk's own line), Arabic/English toggle, pages / , /sinan, /romy, /privacy, /terms.
- Static site on Vercel: plain HTML/CSS/JS, no framework, must be fast on a phone. Owners are busy and mostly on phones.

## What we want from you
A redesign proposal we can build. Be specific and opinionated, not generic.
